title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Role: Payroll Assistant

Location: West Midlands - Hybrid (1 day a week)

Duration: 3 Months

Hourly rate: up to £17.24 + Holiday per hour

Full Time: 36 hours per week

Sellick Partnership are currently recruiting for a Payroll Assistant to join our reputable public sector organisation based in West Midlands. This is a contract for 3 months, with a possibility to be extended, and is offered on a hybrid basis with a minimum of 1 day a week in the office.

The duties of the Payroll Assistant will include:
- Processing weekly and monthly payroll information
- Inputting employee data, including starters, leavers and contract changes
- Recording overtime, bonuses, commission payments and deductions
- Calculating statutory payments such as sick pay, maternity pay and paternity pay
- Checking timesheets and attendance records for accuracy
- Maintaining employee payroll records and personnel files
- Processing pension contributions and benefit deductions
- Responding to employee payroll queries and resolving discrepancies
- Producing payroll reports for management and finance teams
- Ensuring compliance with payroll legislation and company policies
- Submitting payroll data to HMRC and other relevant bodies
- Reconciling payroll reports and identifying any errors before payment runs
- Assisting with year-end payroll activities, including P60s and P11 Ds where required

The Payroll Assistant ideally should:
- Have a minimum of 2 years payroll experience
- Be educated to GCSE mathematics or equivalent
- Have experience in a similar level
- Have knowledge and understanding of current payroll legislation
- Have knowledge of statutory legislation including taxation, NI, SSP, SMP, SPP and P45s and P46s

The Payroll Assistant will need to have excellent communication skills and effectively be able to communicate to stakeholders of all levels. Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have an impeccable eye for detail and accuracy to ensure all workload is carried out effectively and efficiently. They will also need to able to prioritise their workload and be efficient and effective to meet unpredictable deadlines and deal with conflicting demands, whilst working in a high-pressured environment.

If you believe that you are well-suited to this excellent opportunity of Payroll Assistant, please apply directly or contact Charlotte Broomfield at Sellick Partnership for more information. The closing date for CVs is Tuesday 23th October due to the urgent requirement of this role. The closing date may be bought forward should suitable applicants apply.

Sellick Partnership is proud to be an inclusive and accessible recruitment business and we support applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Please note, our advertisements use years' experience, hourly rates, and salary levels purely as a guide and we assess applications based on the experience and skills evidenced on the CV. For information on how your personal details may be used by Sellick Partnership, please review our data processing notice on our website.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
We are recruiting on behalf of a dynamic and growing organisation based in Shropshire that is looking for an experienced and highly organised Project Coordinator to join their team. This is a fantastic opportunity to step into a pivotal role within a business that is genuinely ambitious, fast-moving, and invested in the people who help drive it forward.

Working in a hybrid capacity, you will have the flexibility to split your time between the London office and home, while playing a central role in the coordination and delivery of key projects across the business. If you are someone who thrives on keeping multiple workstreams on track, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and making sure things get done to the highest standard, this role is for you.

What You Will Be Doing
- Leading the day-to-day coordination of projects from initiation through to successful delivery
- Managing project timelines, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring deadlines are consistently met
- Facilitating project meetings, capturing actions, and holding teams accountable for progress
- Maintaining comprehensive project documentation, risk registers, and status reports
- Acting as a central point of contact between internal teams, senior stakeholders, and external partners
- Proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and blockers - and escalating or resolving them swiftly
- Supporting resource planning, budget tracking, and reporting as required
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of project management processes and ways of working

What We Are Looking For
- Proven experience in a Project Coordinator, Project Manager, or similar delivery-focused role
- Strong understanding of project management methodologies (e.g. Agile, PRINCE2, or similar)
- Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects
- Confident communicator - able to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels, including senior leadership
- Proficient in project management tools such as Jira, Asana, MS Project, or equivalent
- A proactive, solutions-focused mindset with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working independently in a hybrid environment
- A relevant project management qualification (e.g. PRINCE2, APM, PMP) is desirable but not essential

What Is On Offer
- Hybrid working - a flexible split between the London office and home
- 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- A high-profile role with genuine influence over project outcomes and business direction
- Fantastic opportunities to grow within the organisation, with clear pathways for career progression
- Funded training and support for professional development and project management qualifications
- A collaborative, ambitious team culture where your contribution is recognised and rewarded

This organisation is recruiting directly through Consula, their recruitment partner.
working_arrangement_evidence: Working in a hybrid capacity, you will have the flexibility to split your time between the London office and home, while playing a central role in the coordination and delivery of key projects across the business.

title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Role Details

Role: Property Manager

Location: Shrewsbury

Salary: £28,000-£31,000

Role Overview

Durrant Talent Solutions is proud to be partnering with a leading national residential managing agent in the search for a Property Manager to join their Shrewsbury team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Property Manager to take ownership of a residential portfolio, delivering exceptional property management services while building strong relationships with leaseholders, residents, clients and contractors.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring developments are managed to the highest professional standards, maintaining compliance, overseeing maintenance and service delivery, and providing an outstanding customer experience across their portfolio.

Role Responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of residential leasehold developments.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with leaseholders, Resident Management Companies (RMCs), Right to Manage Companies (RTMs) and freeholder clients.
- Prepare and manage annual service charge budgets in conjunction with internal teams.
- Monitor expenditure and ensure developments are managed within approved budgets.
- Arrange, attend and chair site inspections and client meetings as required.
- Instruct, monitor and review contractors to ensure works are completed to the required standard.
- Oversee planned and reactive maintenance across the portfolio.
- Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation, including fire, asbestos, water hygiene and lift regulations.
- Work closely with internal departments including finance, compliance and customer services.
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries and resolve issues effectively.
- Ensure accurate property records are maintained and all administration is completed within agreed timescales.

Essential Experience

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience managing a residential block management portfolio.
- A good understanding of residential leasehold legislation and property management best practice.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied workload.
- A proactive and customer-focused approach.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and work independently.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- A full UK driving licence (where required).

Desirable Experience
- TPI qualified or working towards level 3
- Experience using property management software such as Qube, TRAMPS, Propman or similar.

Equal Opportunities Statement

Durrant Talent Solutions is committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion throughout the recruitment process. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under the Equality Act 2010. Selection decisions are based solely on skills, experience, qualifications and suitability for the role.

Due to the high volume of applications received, we may only be able to contact candidates who are shortlisted. If you do not hear from us within 7 days of submitting your application, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

Location: Shawbury, Shropshire,

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Join Our Team

We are looking for a proactive and organised Credit Controller to join our finance team to support our UK and EU businesses. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced individual who is passionate about maintaining strong customer relationships while ensuring effective debt management.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain accurate customer ledgers, review ageing reports, and provide clear insight into outstanding balances, debt trends, and collection priorities
- Identify and escalate customers who may be experiencing cash-flow difficulties or present increased credit risk.
- Handle incoming emails through designated shared mailboxes and respond to customer queries promptly.
- Liaise with internal departments and business managers where appropriate to support the cash collection process.
- Set-up of new customer accounts and amendments to existing accounts, ensuring all relevant information and documentation is maintained accurately.
- Support the month-end close process and provide information required for regular and month-end reporting.
- Support the preparation of information relating to VAT requirements and assist with VAT returns where appropriate.

About You

The ideal candidate will have:
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong customer service approach.
- Ability to prioritise workflow and deliver required outputs within agreed timescales.
- Logical thinking and problem-solving ability.
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of tasks.
- Flexible, hands-on approach with the ability to assist with ad-hoc requirements.
- Commitment to quality and procedural compliance.

Desirable
- Experience of using finance systems and technology to improve processes.
- Relevant accounting qualification or equivalent experience

What We Offer
- Up to 5% match Company pension scheme.
- 4 x annual life assurance.
- Half day Friday
- Semi-flexible start and finish time
- Private medical insurance
- Employee Assistance Scheme
- Ride to work scheme
- Supportive and friendly working environment.

This is a hybrid role, with full-time on-site attendance required initially during the training and onboarding period. Hybrid working arrangements will be introduced once you are fully up to speed in the role, this is likely to be a minimum of 6 months.

Smithers is an equal opportunities employer

title: Service Advisor - Volkswagen Shrewsbury
description:
Service Advisor - Volkswagen Shrewsbury

Good, honest, rewarding work. It's how we're built.

In the heart of our aftersales department our Service Advisors are committed to delivering outstanding and trusted experiences for our customers. As a Service Advisor you are the main point of contact for all customer communication while the vehicle is undergoing maintenance and repair in our Retail Centre.

As part of a successful, global automotive group, you'll broaden your experience across both sites and brands. And with the right support from us, you'll be able to progress as high as you can aim.

What we can offer you
- Enjoy 33 days of annual leave (including bank holidays) to rest and recharge
- Save money every day with our exclusive retail discounts
- Drive a great deal with discounts on new and used cars, plus servicing offers
- Plan for the years ahead with our company pension scheme
- Balance home and work with our industry-leading family-friendly policies designed to help you spend more time with the people that matter
- Commute for less with our cycle-to-work scheme
- Prioritise your wellbeing with dedicated support for you and your family
- 24/7 access to healthcare professionals, ensuring you get the expert advice you need quickly and easily
- Make a difference with a paid day to volunteer in your community
- Invest in your future with our company share purchase plan
- Earn financial rewards when you refer a friend to join the team
- Keep learning and growing with our training and development opportunities for everyone.
- Life assurance with the option to increase cover
- We're open to flexible working options - just ask

What you'll do day to day
- Warmly welcome and engage customers in a friendly and professional manner throughout the day
- Keep customers informed and updated on the progress of their vehicle repairs, ensuring transparency and trust
- Develop and maintain comprehensive product knowledge, enhancing expertise through manufacturer-led training
- Actively promote additional services and repairs based on Technician recommendations, helping customers maintain vehicle health and increasing service revenue
- Schedule vehicles for appointments in the workshop efficiently and accurately
- Conduct pre-appointment customer calls to confirm bookings, ensure readiness, and address any preliminary questions
- Maintain precise and up-to-date customer records within our systems for effective service management

Helpful skills and qualifications

Don't worry about ticking off every single skill here if you care about delivering great experiences as much as we do, we want to hear from you.
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers and colleagues
- Demonstrated experience in delivering exceptional customer service
- Skilled at identifying customer needs and opportunities for upselling
- Excellent time management skills and the ability to work under pressure
- Previous experience in a target driven role, demonstrating the ability to meet goals
- Must hold a valid UK driving licence

We value diversity and believe it strengthens our team. If you don't meet every requirement listed but are enthusiastic about this role and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply.

Be part of something big

Group 1 Automotive is on an exciting growth journey. We are home to over 7000 colleagues dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, with 114 dealerships in the UK, representing 21 brands at the forefront of automotive retail.

But you don't need to love cars to work with us - just need to share our mission to create outstanding and trusted experiences for our customers, our partners, and our people.

Our Values

At Group 1 Automotive we pride ourselves on our five core values that are incorporated in all we that do.

Respect - Integrity - Transparency - Teamwork - Professionalism

These are the principles that every member of our team lives by, whether that be business functions, customer interactions, how we interact with the local community and even how we view each other in the team.

title: Finance Assistant

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively

title: Receptionist
description: Receptionist and Administrator Vacancy Full Time Receptionist Working days/hours - Monday to Friday, hours between 8:00 am and 6:30 pm. An exciting opportunity to join our friendly and welcoming Reception team, working across two sites, in our five-doctor GP partnership, based in rural Shropshire, just south of Shrewsbury. Main duties of the job To provide a first point of contact for patients at the reception desk, and on the telephones, and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. To book and manage appointments and provide reception cover across both of our practice sites. JOB DESCRIPTION RECEPTIONIST Responsible To: Practice Manager PURPOSE OF POST: To provide a point of contact for patients and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff. To book appointments and provide reception cover across both of our practice sites. Major Duties and Responsibilities of the Post Duties: Ensure efficiency of the EMIS computerized appointment system and monitor the flow of patients into consulting rooms. Ensure that patients without appointments but who need to see a doctor urgently are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Respond to all requests for assistance from patients and other visitors EMIS Appointment System: Ensure accurate and timely entries are made onto the patient administration system, EMIS. Book appointments and recalls ensuring sufficient information is recorded to retrieve medical records Monitor effectiveness of the system and report any problems or variations required Management of Medical Records: Retrieve and re file records if required, ensuring that strict alphabetical order is adhered to Operation of Telephone System: Receive and make calls as required. Divert calls and take accurate messages as required Ensure that the system is operational at the beginning of each day and switch to night service at the end of each day Start and End of Day Procedures: Open up premises at the start of day, making tea & coffee and make all necessary preparations to receive patients Download Shropdoc reports, print off and pass to duty GP Any other delegated duties considered appropriate to the post Special Requirements of the Post: An understanding, acceptance and adherence to the need for strict confidentiality as failure to do so will result in dismissal An ability to use own judgment, resourcefulness, common sense to respond to patients non clinical inquiries and requests Excellent communication skills Accuracy in transcribing information Ability to work without supervision and determine own workload priorities Keyboard skills and computer literacy skills desirable Ability to work well within a team and under pressure Ability to be flexible within the working week if needed, and to be prepared to work some evenings and weekends as and when required

title: Receptionist

You would be joining our supportive and friendly practice, providing a high standard of care to our patient population. Although experience of primary care is beneficial we are also interested in those with transferable skills. Good communication skills and a friendly but professional "can do" attitude is essential. We would be flexible for the right candidate but are looking for someone to join us on a full time basis, permanent contract. Ensure that patients without appointments but who need to see a doctor urgently are seen in a logical and non-disruptive manner. Respond to all requests for assistance and information from patients and other visitors Ensure all requests for prescriptions are actioned as per practice policy Ensure that all shared areas of the building are kept neat and tidy Management of EMIS Appointment Systems: Book appointments ensuring sufficient information is recorded to retrieve medical records Management of Medical Records: Retrieve and file records Ensure correspondence e.g. Reports, hospital letters, results are properly scanned and then filed accurately and in the correct order Operation of Telephone System: Receive calls, make calls, divert calls and take accurate messages as required. PURPOSE OF POST: To provide a point of contact for patients and act as a focal point of communication between patients, doctors, the Primary Health Care Team and the administration staff.
